title: 'That's so AI ' What gen Alpha's biggest insult tells us
summary: The Guardian article explores how 'That's so AI' has become a prevalent insult among Generation Alpha, used to dismiss content perceived as fake, soulless, or derivative. The phrase reflects a cultural backlash against AI-generated content and signals younger generations' preference for authentic human creativity over automated outputs. The article examines what this linguistic trend reveals about evolving attitudes toward authenticity and technology.
problem_solved: Illustrates how Gen Alpha uses linguistic pushback to distinguish authentic human expression from AI-generated content
why_valuable: Provides cultural insight into generational attitudes toward AI and human creativity, highlighting the social dynamics of technological rejection
